Internal build of the nao desktop app. Install the file for your system below, then add your nao server (nao Cloud or a self-hosted URL) and sign in. Installed apps update themselves.

- **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel): `nao_<version>_universal.dmg`, then drag nao to Applications.
- **Windows**: `nao_<version>_x64-setup.exe`. SmartScreen warns about an unknown publisher: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Linux**: the `.AppImage` or the `.deb`.

To chat on your own Claude plan instead of the server's models, install Claude Code and sign in once with `claude` in a terminal. Then pick a model under "Your Claude Code" in the chat (experimental).
